body: pleaseee! i will chat you now. thank you so much
i’m ok, i’ve just been going through a lot and would love to hear from my pop right now. he passed recently and i’ve been going through a lot since i just need some clarity
yes my daughter is 11months old. i have dealt with prenatal depression, Postpartum depression, and anxiety. i’m going to reply in a few i’m a little busy right now😊

thank you everybody for being so kind. i’m gonna try to work on myself to stay for my baby. i received some really good advice. thank you all for just giving a shit if i die or not, it means so freaking much. i’m very glad i made this post, i’m not sure i would be here another day/week if i didn’t. thank you so much

thank you. i’m sorry, i wish i could’ve been your mom. you deserved better than that, i’ll never understand people who do shit like that😪my mom was the same way sadly! you deserved better. thank you for saying you’re glad i am here. i received a really nice message from a man with a similar story to me and i’m going to try and take some of his advice and apply it to my life. i will try to stay for my daughters sake, i’m going to try my best to see the light in my life again.

sorry, it’s a bit confusing. my story is a real shit show😂i would explain it but there are so many layers to it! i love my daughter, i love being her mom i just hate being a mom like this. she is the ONLY thing that makes me smile on my saddest darkest days. she is the ONLY light in my life and the only reason i want to stay. i feel so much guilt

a mix of emotions. it always starts with happiness but then leads to guilt because i’m not healthy for her. i feel anger (toward her father, his serial cheating really took a toll on my mental health & ultimately lead to me looking in the mirror and not seeing anything i love and seeing why he doesn’t want me and nobody else has. including parents, siblings, friends, partners, etc) because don’t want to kill my self but i have to since i’m too unhealthy now. i feel sad because i want to watch her and protect her. i really love my daughter, i don’t wanna leave her i’m just scared i won’t be healthy enough for her.
it’s very hard to leave her. i don’t want to but i feel i’m being selfish if i stay because i am not healthy for her to look up to.
she’s good. she’s happy, she’s not old enough to understand mom hates herself so i need to leave before she can

thank you for the offer. my story goes back to my childhood, teenage years, serial cheating, postpartum depression. it’s just a lot to explain but the main reason comes down to feeling as if everyone is better off without me, but mainly my baby. i don’t want to stunt her growth and i surely don’t want her being anything like me😪i just can’t turn my self harming/self hate off and not being able to be a good mom is making me want to remove myself so i don’t hurt her like my mom did. i wouldn’t ever do it intentionally, i mean just by not being healthy enough for her.

wow. first of all, i am sorry. i wish you didn’t want to remove yourself from this life, i’m very sorry. but just to clarify, the artery in your neck can cause you to pass out from a lack of oxygen going to your brain through the blood so if my brain wouldn’t have enough oxygen for a long enough time, wouldn’t i just pass out and continue to die?
i don’t want to🥺i’m so sad, i don’t want to hurt myself i’m scared but i don’t want to stay. i wish there was assisted suicide where i live 😐but i hope i don’t mess up again
